payload.title: Normalize malformed UTF8 model HTTP responses without losing HTTP status
payload.summary: P2: public LlamaCppInteraction.send with correctly framed body byte ff leaks UnicodeDecodeError both for HTTP200 and500. Expected typed LlamaCppResponseError for successful-status malformed body and LlamaCppHttpError retaining500 for error response. Current _post_json/_error_detail decode outside appropriate normalization. One invocation, finally closes connection, no observation or retry. Preserve primary HTTP status, causal decoding detail and existing valid/chunked/error controls; add real maintained-caller deterministic wire regressions. Baseline a7a49cc18f3b40a5bf4e3897ca30d9a5cddc30d1. Acceptance: 200 invalid UTF8 yields ResponseError;500 invalid UTF8 yields HttpError withstatus500; valid UTF8/JSON unchanged; exactly one request and closed writer; no retry or fabricated observation.
payload.benefit: Make the existing supported boundary conservative and reliable without inventing new lifecycle or authority.
payload.uncertainty: Deterministic maintained-call probes, not live model/GPU/Docker proof. Production correction is not authorized by this audit; preserve ownership and public compatibility.
dependencies: Existing ADR-0001 ModelInteraction/Serving ownership and current public error/JSON/config contracts; no new architectural approval implied.
